names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Arsenie Capadocianul»; the bare personal name, without the epithet.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Αρσένιος ο Καππαδόκης», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 28 октября ст. ст., «Арсений Капподакийский, прп.», with the rank word left off. The name page spells the by-name «Капподакийский» where the day line spells it «Каппадокийского»; the form is stored as the link prints it, which is how every other form in this corpus is stored.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Pe numele de botez Teodor, părintele Arsenie Capadocianul s-a născut în satul Kefalohori, din ținutul Farasa, la anul 1840».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «și-a dat sufletul în mâinile Domnului la 10 noiembrie 1924, având în mâini moaștele Sfântului Ioan Gură de Aur».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Арсения Каппадокийского (1924).»
source.note: The line stands in the day's second paragraph, which carries no typikon icon, so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian keeps him on the Julian 28 October, which is the civil 10 November the Greek and Romanian pages already gave this folder; the day is the same day and the calendars differ, not the reading. It agrees on the year of his death, 1924. No life page follows the line. His name page carries this day alone and two articles, one of them reporting that an icon of him with a portion of his relics was given to the Сретенский monastery at Moscow on 17 July.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 10 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Arsenie Capadocianul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Αρσένιος ο Καππαδόκης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and its head line «(1840 - 1924)» agrees with the years the folder holds from doxologia. The page is very long — some 25,000 characters — and the paragraph added to the life takes only its opening and its note of where his relics are; the rest has not been read. Its first apolytikion, which names him, is taken here; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» in Ἦχος γ’ is not drafted, and the page prints no kontakion. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Viaţă plăcută lui Dumnezeu petrecând şi vas cinstit Mângâietorului făcându-te, purtătorule de Dumnezeu Arsenie, te-ai arătat şi primitor al darului facerii de minuni, tuturor dându-le grabnic ajutor, Părinte Cuvioase, pe Hristos Dumnezeu roagă-L să ne dăruiască nouă mare milă.

english.text: Having led a life pleasing to God, and having become an honoured vessel of the Comforter, God-bearing Arsenios, thou wast shown to be a receiver of the gift of wonderworking, giving swift help to all; venerable father, entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.

hymns.text: Τῶν Ὁσίων τὸν βίον ἐκμιμησάμενος, ἐν ἐσχάτοις τοὶς χρόνοις, Πάτερ Ἀρσένιε, ἐπληρώθης δωρεῶν τοῦ θείου Πνεύματος, καὶ θαυμάτων γεγονός, θεοφόρε αὐτουργός, παρέχεις ἐνὶ ἐκάστω, τᾶς ἐκ Θεοῦ χορηγίας, ταὶς ἰκεσίαις σου πρὸς Κύριον.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Αρσένιος ο Καππαδόκης», and it names him.

english.text: Having imitated the life of the venerable fathers in these last times, father Arsenios, you were filled with the gifts of the divine Spirit; and having become, God-bearer, a worker of wonders yourself, you grant to each one the supplies that come from God, by your entreaties to the Lord.
